stored.title: Labor
stored.summary: Condominium employs no labor; common-area upkeep handled per note 6.

stored.title: Gas
stored.summary: Common areas and individual units will not utilize gas service.

stored.title: Electric
stored.summary: No common area electric meter; common-area electricity billed to the adjacent unit; see Schedule B-1 for individual unit costs.

stored.title: Water and Sewer
stored.summary: Per Complete Condo Service Inc. opinion (11/30/2023): water $4.30/HCF and sewer $6.83/HCF x 146.98 HCF estimated annual usage = $1,800.

stored.title: Service Contracts
stored.summary: Exterminator $125/year per Gormigor Corp. estimate; no janitorial service; Unit Owners handle own refuse and front-of-building upkeep.

stored.title: Insurance
stored.summary: Per LHB Insurance Brokerage, Inc. estimate (11/22/2023): building $580,000 all-risk agreed amount, liability $1,000,000/$2,000,000, D&O $1,000,000, $1,000 deductible, annual premium $2,438; excess liability and workers comp available at extra cost.

stored.title: Management Fees
stored.summary: Board of Managers will self-manage; if an outside management company is later retained, cost is typically 4-6% of gross common charges (min. ~$600/month), raising common charges by at least 30%.

stored.title: Office Expenses
stored.summary: Covers office supplies, photocopying, postage and other miscellaneous office expenses.

stored.title: Legal Fees and Audit Fees
stored.summary: $1,400 for unaudited/audited financial statement per Mozes Guttman, CPA estimate (11/30/2023); $500 for miscellaneous legal fees; attorney not yet selected.

check.fix: The $1,400 figure in the Guttman proposal is specifically for the unaudited financial statement; the audited statement cost is separately stated as 'approximately $1,400.00' (not explicitly part of the Guttman proposal per the text, though same figure). Claim conflates both as one estimate from Guttman; footnote attributes only the unaudited figure to Guttman's proposal.
check.why: footnote ties $1,400 unaudited fee to Guttman proposal; audited fee of $1,400 stated separately without explicit sourcing to Guttman

judge.printed: Per Mozes Guttman, CPA (2 Skillman St #217, Brooklyn) proposal dated 11/30/2023, an unaudited financial statement is estimated at $1,400.00. Audited statements are required while Sponsor controls the Board, at approximately $1,400.00; this figure is not attributed to Guttman. $500.00 for legal fees. The attorney will be chosen later. Litigation costs are excluded.

stored.title: Contingency Fund
stored.summary: Deposit fund for unanticipated expenses or increases in projected expenses.

stored.title: Reserve Fund
stored.summary: Deposit fund for major capital repairs/replacements expected within first five years; distinct from the contingency fund, which covers day-to-day items.
